applies_to: structured quotation payloads with complete product lines
same_connection: existing caller-owned SQLite writer transaction; no commit, rollback, or repricing
issuer_and_customer: exact current company issuer reference and Foundation record
sales_tax: dedicated sales_tax_application only; purchase-cost tax_application is rejected
exact CN-M01, quotation_sale, issuer, customer, subject kind and subject revision
current published application, policy, evidence, source verification and object control
current tax profile with finite rate in [0,1], known recovery treatment and explicit basis
not_applicable is accepted only at zero rate
inclusive/exclusive split uses exact rational arithmetic then per-line HALF_UP minor rounding
seller_charges: current fee_type side sales_charge and exact configured separate/included_in_line value
one fixed income obligation per fee_type ID in a quote; duplicate IDs, keys, or fee reuse are rejected
explicit nonempty charge_id, obligation_key, positive bounded amount and current verified source evidence
separate amounts are added once; included amounts are not added or taxed a second time
included charge must bind an existing line, share its exact tax_profile revision, and aggregate no higher than its unrounded discounted line base
no negative, agency, pass-through, layered inclusion, split obligation, or multiple obligations of one fee type
frozen_evidence: calculation.sales_terms_binding with issuer/customer, publication/source hashes, tax bindings, charge bindings, and deterministic binding_hash
historical_behavior: old calculations remain readable; missing or mismatched sales certificate cannot authorize a new formalization or order adoption; committed recovery does not rewrite history
arithmetic: exact Fraction input composition, HALF_UP minor-unit boundaries, existing 24-digit minor-unit limit
not_certified: tax law or actual jurisdictional application
multiple income obligations per fee type and cross-configuration economic deduplication
customer trade-profile/address completeness and full quotation runtime
all physical-commit dependency deadlines, general risk lifecycle, and production recovery
all Q03-01..48 scenarios or G01..G06 gates
